about.bio:
I'm Drew. I build brands and the growth engines behind them. I founded [Gorilla Gear](https://gorillagear.club), a fitness nutrition brand built for Asia, and I'm the Founding SDR at MagicPort.

I also train people, model and make content. I'm based in Singapore and open to growth roles in SF, LA or NY. [More about my work.](/work/)

journal.title: Starting here
journal.body:
This is where I'll write about building brands, selling, training and whatever else I'm figuring out.

Replace this post with your first real entry.

work.intro: I like being the first person through the door: building the brand, the funnel or the sales motion before there's a playbook for it.

gorilla.story:
Gorilla Gear is a premium fitness and nutrition brand built for Asia. We launched in May 2025 and I bootstrapped it to more than US$130K ARR in the first 12 months.

I run the growth side end to end: paid acquisition, retention, B2B partnerships and the brand itself.
gorilla.points:
Grew revenue 10x through paid acquisition and B2B partnerships, reaching a consistent US$20K+ MRR
Ran Meta Ads at more than 4x ROAS, shipping about 30 creatives a month at peak with matching landing pages
Built Klaviyo retention flows behind a 30% repeat rate across 1,000+ customers
Closed 5+ B2B accounts across lifestyle and fitness channels through outbound
Ran gym and lifestyle activations; the largest drew 200+ people over two days

magicport.story:
MagicPort is an AI-powered maritime intelligence platform that digitizes port operations. As the first sales hire, I built the outbound motion and the cold prospecting playbook from scratch.

In my first 6 months I generated US$250K in outbound pipeline across 300+ shipping companies in 80+ countries.
magicport.points:
Work with the founders on go-to-market, refining messaging and qualification to lift meeting conversion
Run pipeline and sales activity in HubSpot

creative.intro: Alongside building brands, I make content and model. I've grown a following of 25K+ across [Instagram](https://instagram.com/drewtyl) and [TikTok](https://tiktok.com/@drewtyl), and worked with brands on campaigns, UGC and micro-influencer work.
